name: dataproduct-builder-demo-databricks
description: Demo-grade builder for Databricks (Unity Catalog) dbt data products with Entropy Data.

interface.displayName: Data Product Builder for dbt on Databricks (Demo)
interface.shortDescription: Demo builder for Databricks dbt data products.
interface.longDescription: Streamlined demo plugin that scaffolds a Databricks (Unity Catalog) dbt project for a published Entropy Data data product, generates the output-port models from the ODCS contract, runs dbt with OpenLineage, runs dbt and data contract tests, and seeds a GitHub Actions reference workflow. Three skills: dataproduct-bootstrap, dataproduct-implement, and datacontract-test.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap a Databricks dbt data product.
